newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKOBANK TO CUT OP-PRIME RATE TO 4.25 PCT.
newsitem.headline: OKOBANK TO CUT OP-PRIME RATE TO 4.25 PCT.

text.p: Osuuspankkien Keskuspankki Oy (OKOBANK) said in a statement on Friday it will lower the cooperative banking group's OP-Prime reference rate to 4.25 percent from 4.75 percent effective on October 16.
In line with an earlier decision, OP-Prime will fall to 4.75 percent from 5.00 percent on October 1, it said.
"The fall in the (OP-Prime) interest rate is based on the fall in market interest rates and moderate inflation expectations," OKOBANK said.
